items.reason: The question clearly asks how long they served as priests. The passage explicitly supplies “直到被掳之日,” and only A answers that relation.
“最先发生了什么事” clearly tests sequence. The five men take the images before the priest takes them, supporting C.
The single temporal setup “百姓出去掠夺叙利亚营之前” is clear. “侦察者回来告诉王” is the immediately preceding event.
The options impose unnecessary list comparison: A and D repeat “住在姑珥巴力的阿拉伯人和米乌尼人,” while B also rearranges overlapping peoples and locations. This burdens an otherwise clear identification question.
The stem gives away the requested actor: “王求神人为他祷告” identifies 神人 immediately before asking “谁为王祷告了？”

“After the man of God leaves” does not identify which departure. He leaves Bethel before meeting the old prophet and later leaves the prophet’s house before the lion attack; the event setup needs clarification.
The supplied excerpt never identifies the man as “从犹大来的.” Thus the full identity asserted by the keyed option C is not supported by this passage.

Option B says “The evil spirit beat them,” but the passage says “the man who had the evil spirit” attacked and beat them. The intended outcome is supported, but the option misidentifies the immediate actor.
“The woman who spoke to the king” clearly identifies the speaker without nested tracking. Her complaint that the other woman “had hidden him” supports the expected answer.
The single temporal clause “when the man of God prays” is clear. The passage directly states that the king’s hand was restored after his intercession.
